title: Real-integral form of a lower-integral Gagliardo–Nirenberg–Sobolev inequality (parent step 0)
statement: Let P be a natural number, p > 0 a real number and C ≥ 0 a real constant (an element of NNReal, viewed in [0, ∞] in the hypothesis). Write L^P = volume on R^P = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P), ∫⁻ for the lower Lebesgue integral with values in [0, ∞], ‖t‖ₑ ∈ [0, ∞] for the extended norm and |Dw(x)| for the operator norm of the derivative. Assume (H): every C¹ function w : R^P → R with compact support satisfies ∫⁻ ‖w(x)‖ₑ^p dL^P(x) ≤ C · (∫⁻ ‖Dw(x)‖ₑ dL^P(x))^p. Then there is a real number c > 0 such that every C¹ function w : R^P → R with compact support satisfies (∫ |w|^p dL^P)^{1/p} ≤ c ∫ |Dw| dL^P, with Bochner integrals and real powers (the power 1/p is written p⁻¹).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (p : ℝ) (C : NNReal), 0 < p → (∀ w : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 w → HasCompactSupport w → ∫⁻ x, ‖w x‖ₑ ^ p ≤ (C : ℝ≥0∞) * (∫⁻ x, ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖ₑ) ^ p) → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 w → HasCompactSupport w → (∫ z, |w z| ^ p) ^ p⁻¹ ≤ c * ∫ z, ‖fderiv ℝ w z‖
